[06_how_to_claim#2]
How to make a claim. 1. An itemised receipt from the provider, showing the treatment, the date and the amount. Every claim needs one; a payment card slip or bank statement is not an itemised receipt. 2. A referral, if the treatment needs one: - consultant visits need a referral from your GP; - physiotherapy needs a referral from a GP or consultant. 3. A pre-authorisation number, for a day case procedure or an inpatient stay.

[05_pre_authorisation#6]
Pre-authorisation. Other treatment. GP visits, consultant visits, physiotherapy and prescriptions do not need pre-authorisation, but consultant visits and physiotherapy need a referral. See "Cover and annual limits".

[03_exclusions#2.5]
What is not covered. Fitness and wellness classes, for example yoga, pilates and gym membership. This applies even if a class is described as therapeutic or is run at a clinic.

[01_plan_overview#6]
Your Essential Plus plan: overview. When cover starts. Most treatment has a waiting period after you join. See "Waiting periods".

[04_waiting_periods#2]
Waiting periods. How the days are counted. The date your cover began is day 0, so the waiting period is days 0 to 181 and cover starts on day 182, which is 182 days after your cover began. For example, if your cover began on 1 March 2026, treatment on 29 August 2026 (day 181) is not covered and treatment on 30 August 2026 (day 182) is covered.
